newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish industrialist's body stolen from grave.
newsitem.headline: Turkish industrialist's body stolen from grave.

text.p: The body of Turkish industrialist Vehbi Koc who died in February aged 95 was stolen from its grave in an Istanbul cemetery on Thursday, Anatolian news agency said.
His body was taken from Zincirlikuyu cemetery at 5.30 p.m., Anatolian said. It was not known who took the body or why. Turkish television showed pictures of the open grave with soil around it.

Koc started his business life in 1917 running a grocery store and built an industrial empire with a turnover of $8.2 billion and 32,700 employees by the time he died. The Koc Holding company is now run by his son Rahmi.
